newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks to edge higher on technical rebound.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks to edge higher on technical rebound.

text.p: Seoul stocks are likely to creep higher on a technical rebound led by bargain hunting on securities issues, brokers said on Friday.
They said institutional interest in blue chip counters could also help the rise.
The composite stock index closed Thursday down 0.65 points at 744.34.
"The market would attempt a rebound but the gain would be limited on lack of good news," said a Dongsuh Securities broker.
Brokers said the May current account figures released by the Bank of Korea at 0400 GMT were unlikely to have a big impact on the market, unless the figures were exceptionally positive.
